text:
Lena Ortiz: Quick thought 1 — what if we run a 5-week pilot that uses an 'owner heatmap' + time-budget rules to reduce follow-up drag on postmortems?
Marcus Hill: owner heatmap? curious how that maps to actions.
Lena Ortiz: visual board showing who has most open actions and avg age. combine with a time-budget: owners get 48h ack budget, 7d execution budget, 14d finalization budget.
Sofia Reyes: I like time budgets. makes expectations explicit. can we auto-tag actions that cross budgets?
Jamal Price: yes 1 auto-tags would be great. e.g., tag "budget-breach" at 8d and escalate if 10d.
ops-bot: automation note: "time-budget-notifier" scheduled -> DMs to owners at 48h, 7d, 10d for flagged items
Marcus Hill: operational detail: steward role still useful, but stewardship shifts weekly and focuses on triaging budget-breaches rather than every action.
Lena Ortiz: steward = 1-week rotation, triage breaches, run a 20m sprint with owners on Thursdays. low friction.
Sofia Reyes: owner heatmap columns: owner | open-actions | avg-age | breaches | last-update. surface in ops-dashboard.
Jamal Price: recurrence detection idea: heatmap overlays recurrence hotspots (services with repeated PMs). color-code red if 2+ incidents in 60d.
Marcus Hill: escalation flow: owner -> steward -> oncall lead -> manager. steward pings first in DM, channel only if escalated.
Lena Ortiz: comms template (one-line): "hi <owner>, quick check on PM action <id>: status? blocker? ETA?" keep it terse.
Sofia Reyes: metrics to track: median time-to-ack, %within-7d, breach-rate, recurrence-hotspots. update weekly.
Jamal Price: I'll prototype a small script that emits the heatmap CSV from the tracker and computes budgets + recurrence counts. ETA: 5 business days.
Marcus Hill: I'll add a lightweight view to ops-dashboard and wire the bot reminders.
Lena Ortiz: pilot scope: infra + data-plane services only, 5 weeks. opt-in owners first, then expand.
Sofia Reyes: can we add an optional escalation SLA to encourage quicker fixes? e.g., breaches over 10d escalate with reason required.
Jamal Price: agree. require a short remediation note on escalation.
ops-bot: runbook uploaded: /docs/incidents/time-budget-heatmap-runbook.md
Lena Ortiz: action items: Jamal -> prototype script; Marcus -> dashboard view + bot; Sofia -> owner cheat-sheet; I'll publish pilot signup and steward rota tomorrow.
Marcus Hill: no objections. :+1:
Sofia Reyes: :thumbsup:
Jamal Price: signed up for week 1 stewardship.
Lena Ortiz: thanks all 1 will post the kickoff doc and signups in #eng-oncall tomorrow AM.
